data_provenance.basis: Note 20 Earnings per unit: 'Weighted average number of units (basic)' = 652,449 ('000); multiplied to absolute units.
Note 20: 'Weighted average number of units used in calculation of diluted EPU' = 652,653 ('000). Verified DILUTED figure (basic 652,449 + 204 effect of mgmt fees in units). Already correct.

Distribution Statement (p147) discloses a single 'Income for the year available for distribution to Unitholders' = 99,781 ('000). Mgmt fees settled in units are added back as non-cash distribution adjustment (Note A); no separate cash-deducted adjusted distributable income. Set null (DPU method 1).

AUDIT: matches 'Income for the year available for distribution to Unitholders' = 99,781 ('000), the DPU numerator (p147), NOT 'Distributions to Unitholders during the year' 65,436. Correct as stored; no change.

Distribution Statement p147: no separate after-retention 'amount to be distributed for the year' dollar line exists; the 'Distributions to Unitholders during the year' subtotal (65,436) mixes prior-year cash. For-year declared distribution = DPU 15.29c (relates to distributions in respect of FY2025) x 'Number of units entitled to distribution' 652,487 ('000) = 0.1529 x 652,487,000 = 99,765,260. net_distributable_income 99,781,000 is 'Income for the year available for distribution' (already after the disclosed S$3,000k capex retention, line 'Amount retained for capital expenditure'). Retained check: 99,781,000 - 99,765,260 = 15,740 (rounding from the 15.29c DPU rounding); effectively ~100% payout of post-capex-retention income. The standing S$3.0m/yr capex retention is upstream of net_distributable_income.
